collection.title: VW Touareg 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The VW Touareg 2017 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" on the the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Touareg, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.

image.alt: VW Touareg 2017 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
